fullDescription: A high-intensity, dark-mode monitoring interface featuring vibrant red and orange accents, optimized for real-time data visualization and emergency alerts. The design utilizes a 'seismic grid' background pattern, editorial typography with Clash Grotesk, and a high-contrast hierarchy for status severity. Ideal for fintech, cybersecurity, emergency response systems, or performance analytics dashboards that require immediate visual attention and clear categorization of critical information.
prompt:
## Resumo
A bold, high-contrast monitoring dashboard in dark mode, using red-to-orange gradients and 'seismic' aesthetic elements to highlight real-time data status and critical alerts.

## Estilo Visual
Create a high-fidelity UI style characterized by a deep background (#0a0608) accented with a subtle 28px seismic grid pattern in #ff2d55 at 4% opacity. Use a primary gradient of linear-gradient(110deg, #ff2d55 0%, #ff6a00 100%) for active states and primary icons. Typography: Headings in 'Clash Grotesk' with letter-spacing of -0.02em to -0.04em; Body in 'Satoshi'. Severity colors: Critical (#ff2d55), High (#ff6a00), Moderate (#f5c518). Micro-interactions: Use a 1.4s ease-in-out 'blink' animation for live indicators and a 6s linear 'scanline' overlay. Card styling: #130b0e background, 1px solid #2e1520 border, with a 4px left-side accent bar color-coded to severity. Shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header and Navigation
Design a header with a large bold title (26px) and a sub-caption. Include a 'Live' pill component (red background at 12% opacity, red border, and a blinking 6px dot). Below the title, place a full-width search bar (#1a0d11 background, 1.5px border #2e1520, 14px text) followed by a horizontally scrollable row of pill-shaped filter chips (active chips use the red/orange gradient, inactive chips use #1a0d11 with a muted pink text #6b3345).

### Summary Statistics
Create a horizontal grid of 4 minimalist stat cards. Each card has a background of #1a0d11, a 1px border #2e1520, and a 12px padding. Display a 10px uppercase label in #6b3345 above a large 22px bold number color-coded based on its metric (Red for critical, White for neutral).

### Alert List Section
Group items into sections with a 11px uppercase label in #6b3345. Each item is a card with a 4px colored side-bar. Top-right of the card should feature a large 'Magnitude' or 'Value' metric (24px-28px bold). Top-left should feature a 36px square icon container with 15% opacity background matching the severity color. Below the icon/title row, include a row of small metadata badges (#ffffff at 6% opacity backgrounds).

### Expanded Card Detail
Design an expanded state for alert cards that reveals a sub-panel with a 4% opacity red background and 1px border. Inside, include list rows with small icons (Map pin, Clock, Warning) and 12px sub-text. At the bottom of the panel, include a simplified SVG sparkline/waveform representing data trends.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Severity Alert Card — Multi-state card designed for emergency notifications with data visualization elements.
Style a card with #130b0e background. Components: 1. A 4px vertical accent bar on the left (Severity Color). 2. A large numeric 'Value' in Clash Grotesk (e.g., '6.8') with a text-shadow of 20px blur in the same severity color. 3. Metadata badges with font-size 10px, font-weight 700. 4. An 'Expand' button using rgba(255,45,85,0.08) background and 1px solid border. 5. Internal Sparkline: An SVG path stroke-width 1.5 using the severity color, opacity 0.5, to show a jagged waveform.

### Seismic Grid Background — Atmospheric background layer to enhance the technical/monitoring feel.
Implement a CSS background-image using two linear gradients: one vertical and one horizontal, each 1px wide at 28px intervals using color rgba(255,45,85,0.04). Overlay this with a fixed-position scanline: a 2px tall horizontal line with a gradient (transparent to #ff2d55 at 8% opacity to transparent) that translates from -100% to 100vh every 6 seconds.

## Notas Especiais
MUST maintain the high-contrast ratio between the dark background and the vibrant status colors. MUST NOT use generic blue or green colors; stick strictly to the red-orange-yellow severity scale to preserve the emergency-alert theme. MUST ensure all interactive elements (chips, cards) have an active state transition like border-color change or slight scaling.

style.description: Vibrant dark mode with 'emergency' aesthetics. Typography pairs 'Clash Grotesk' (geometric, bold headings) with 'Satoshi' (clean, modern body text). The color palette is rooted in deep blacks and burgundies, with functional color-coding for severity: Critical (Red #ff2d55), High (Orange #ff6a00), and Moderate (Yellow #f5c518). Visual effects include scanline flickers, radial glows, and soft blurs to create depth.
